method.cohort: Every published cohort reproduced from exact representative profiles and its current comparison evidence, excluding comparisonOnly benchmarks.
method.attribution: Same old profiles and old tests without changing test membership isolates data. New profiles on old tests isolates effort and model selection. Final cohort minus this stage isolates common-test composition. Missing tests are listed explicitly; never filled with zero.
method.rankDelta: old rank minus new rank; positive means improvement.
